build_PackTag: build a CLI that packs a protobuf field number and wire type into a 32-bit tag integer
build_UnpackTag: build a CLI that unpacks a 32-bit protobuf tag into its field number and wire type
build_ZigZagEncode: build a CLI that ZigZag encodes a signed integer for efficient varint protobuf serialization
build_ZigZagDecode: build a CLI that decodes a ZigZag encoded varint value back to its original signed integer
build_IsTypePackable: build a CLI that checks whether a protobuf field type supports packed repeated encoding
